description: Thumb-sized, yellowed and worn flat. Grinding teeth like this come out of things that chew all day.
lore: A horse sheds teeth the way any grazing thing does: the worn crown works loose and drops in the grass, and the animal goes on eating and never knows. [[characters/6bb1eb5a|Solveig]] found one at the edge of the firelight, on the line where [[monsters/white_horse|Snowmane]] stops and turns and walks back out into the dark. It brings people in and it will not come in. She picked the tooth up and put it in her apron, and it has been in her apron since, and she is entirely clear about what it is not: it is not thanks, it is not a debt settled, and it does nothing whatever. It is worth twelve gold. It is hers. She keeps it where her hand goes.
gm_notes: Does not cancel the ache in the Snowmane record — Solveig still has not thanked it and says so. The tooth is the nearest she has managed and she refuses to call it more.
